posts.content_md:
We have in the distant past here discussed seeing colours in holograms when they are replayed under monochromatic laser light, --an artefact of our

vision system. Our old friend Graham Saxby has just sent me a direction to a site with a marvellous demonstration of vision artefact defects here:-

[http://www.digbig.com/4tsmf](http://www.digbig.com/4tsmf) 

Jeff
